claim_boundary: This protocol defines a no-training Route-2 V0-FD research path. It does not change any public Route-2 profile, does not claim a chemical-accuracy result, force/PES implementation, or replacement for the legacy Route-2 fixed point. No V0 acceptance claim is permitted without the immutable historical FreeSolv-10 regression panel that contains the prior 7.041442082076966 kcal/mol outlier.

construction.name: route2-v0-fixed-density-v1
construction.solute_state: c0(R) is the unmodified MACE-POLAR gas-phase density evaluated at zero reaction field
construction.solute_response: forbidden: c0 is not updated from a solvent reaction field
construction.continuum_state: sigma*(R,c0)=argmin_sigma [0.5 sigma^T A_R sigma + sigma^T B_R c0]
construction.source_receiver_rule: A source-to-surface map and its energy dual must use one declared density basis and one declared continuum operator.
construction.coordinate_derivative_rule: Any future force must be the full derivative of the same scalar, including dc0/dR and every explicit continuum/cavity derivative.

prohibited_actions: Do not update c0 with the legacy learned local-jet or exact-GTO field response.
Do not repair charge, reciprocity, or passivity by projecting density, symmetrizing a response Jacobian, clipping eigenvalues, damping response, or fitting a scale factor.
Do not use MNSol, FreeSolv, MNSol-derived SMD parameters, or a held-out benchmark score to choose a cavity threshold, dispersion coefficient, solvent correction, or equation arm.
Do not use the best of several methods per record as a reported V0-FD result.
Do not promote a fixed-geometry scalar to a force, PES, optimization, scan, MD, or NVE claim before its independent smooth-cavity derivative gates pass.

solvent_information_contract.dielectric_only_custom_solvent_policy: A custom solvent specified only by static dielectric may run electrostatics-only diagnostics. It must fail closed for a total solvation-free-energy prediction because dielectric response does not determine cavity, dispersion, or molecular solvent structure.
total_free_energy_custom_solvent_require: bulk number density or an equation of state
cavity/free-energy functional data derived independently of target solvation values
dispersion response data or a solvent molecular polarizability model with provenance
for molecular-structure solvent models, a site model and bulk direct-correlation/susceptibility data with provenance
solvent_information_contract.parameter_provenance_rule: Every parameter must be independently measured, ab-initio derived, or supplied by a versioned upstream solvent theory before any target solvation result is inspected.

benchmark_coverage_contract.mnsol_methanol_limitation: MNSol-v2012 contains no neutral absolute methanol rows in the frozen Route-2 domain. It cannot by itself certify the 11th registered solvent.
benchmark_coverage_contract.methanol_neutral_absolute_extension: required-before-11-solvent-chemistry-scoring: independently versioned experimental records, geometry/conformer policy, standard-state convention, and provenance must be frozen before any V0-FD score is read
benchmark_coverage_contract.accuracy_claim_rule: No statement that V0-FD has passed an 11-solvent accuracy gate is permitted until the methanol extension and all 11 runtime solvent strata are frozen and evaluated.

historical_freesolv10_regression.required_rule: every one of the exact ten locked records, using its hash-bound original FreeSolv MOL2 conformer, must have absolute error strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol
historical_freesolv10_regression.relationship_to_11_solvent_gate: mandatory in addition to—not a replacement for—the separately frozen 11-solvent development, confirmation, and blind panels

candidate_nonpolar_policy.smd_cds: retained only as an explicitly empirical comparator; it is not evidence for a no-fit V0-FD core
candidate_nonpolar_policy.weighted_density_cavity_dispersion: admissible only if every cavity and dispersion input is sourced independently of target solvation free energies
candidate_nonpolar_policy.molecular_density_functional_or_rism: admissible as an independent structured-solvent backend only when the solvent site/correlation model is frozen before solvation scoring

validation_sequence: Prove source-to-surface/energy-dual pairing, total-charge conservation, energy-conjugate half-coupling, and stationary continuum residual on synthetic and real fixed-density cases.
Prove coordinate derivatives only after adopting a smooth cavity/operator; current active-set providers remain energy-only controls.

Evaluate the immutable historical ten-record FreeSolv regression manifest route2-v0-historical-freesolv10-regression-v1.json on exactly its original hash-bound MOL2 conformers, including ethyl acetate—the previous 7.041442082076966 kcal/mol outlier—and require every record to have absolute error strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol. The ten records must retain ten distinct chemical-function or scaffold classes. A smaller or different subset, MAE, or RMSE cannot substitute; neither can a chemically narrowed subset.

Freeze an 11-solvent development manifest with replicated chemistry per solvent before any V0-FD chemistry score is read. MNSol-v2012 supplies ten neutral-absolute strata only, so the independently versioned methanol extension is a prerequisite rather than a replaceable gap.
Require every development record to have absolute error strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol; report the maximum error, not only MAE/RMSE.
Freeze a disjoint 11-or-more-solvent confirmation manifest and require every record to remain strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol without any change.
Freeze an external final blind dataset absent from construction, development, confirmation, and model-selection work; require every record to remain strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol.
The stricter future target is every record strictly below 1.0 kcal/mol on development, confirmation, and final blind data.
decision_rule: Failure of any structural gate rejects the candidate before chemistry metrics. Failure of the immutable historical FreeSolv-10 all-record strict maximum-error gate, any 11-solvent per-record gate, confirmation gate, or blind gate rejects the frozen candidate; it does not authorize an error-driven adjustment. A new physical functional requires a new preregistration and an independent review.
